name: templar-of-the-eternal-return-regalia

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] (2), Return a regalia you control to its owner's material deck: Put a buff counter on Templar of the Eternal, and it gains spellshroud until end of turn.

notes: FIXED implicit-REST bug: this ability's printed cost ([Class Bonus] (2), Return a regalia you control to its owner's material deck) has no [REST], but DoActivatedAbility() (Custom/GameLogic.php) set Status=1 as an implicit [REST] for every static ability of an ALLY/CHAMPION/PHANTASIA not in the hard-coded $skipAutoRest list (trace: cardID=peyG8Hfgqt idx=0 static=1 before=2). The old expected_final_gamestate.txt silently pinned the rested state (Status 1); peyG8Hfgqt is now in $skipAutoRest and the unit stays awake (Status 2), asserted explicitly.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Templar of the Eternal's activated ability (printed cost: [Class Bonus] (2), Return a regalia you control to its owner's material deck; no [REST]) also RESTED the unit: DoActivatedAbility() sets Status=1 as the implicit [REST] cost unless the card id is in $skipAutoRest. Fix: add peyG8Hfgqt to $skipAutoRest (same fix as Tristan, Shadowdancer's Redirect).
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php DoActivatedAbility() $skipAutoRest list / implicit REST for static unit abilities
